title: Office Child Process Launches Script Interpreter
logsource:
  product: windows
  category: process_creation
detection:
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\WINWORD.EXE'
      - '\EXCEL.EXE'
      - '\POWERPNT.EXE'
  selection_child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\wscript.exe'
      - '\cscript.exe'
      - '\mshta.exe'
  filter_it_admin:
    CommandLine|contains: 'OfficeAddinHealthCheck'
condition: selection_parent and selection_child and not filter_it_admin
fields: [UtcTime, User, ParentImage, Image, CommandLine, ParentCommandLine]

required_concepts.description: Detects Office applications spawning scripting interpreters or script hosts.
Requires Windows process creation telemetry with parent and child process fields.
Detection hinges on Office parent image and script-host child image.
Office add-ins, sanctioned macros, or IT checks may trigger this.
Tune with known add-ins and validate document origin, user context, and command line.

forbidden_concepts.description: Process ancestry alone does not prove macro content or compromise.
Network logs are enrichment, not required for this process rule.
The explicit filter and add-in use cases should be considered.

title: Repeated DNS TXT Queries To Rare Domain Followed By HTTPS Beacon
logsource:
  category: dns_and_proxy
detection:
  dns_part:
    dns.question.type: TXT
    dns.question.registered_domain_7d_prevalence: '<= 3 hosts'
    count_by_src_domain_10m: '>= 15'
  proxy_part:
    url.domain = dns.question.registered_domain
    http.method: POST
    user_agent|contains: 'python-requests'
    bytes_out: '> 50000'
  filter_known_tools:
    url.domain|endswith: ['.spf-provider.example','.survey-platform.example']
condition: dns_part followed_by proxy_part within 20m same src_ip
fields: [src_ip, dns.question.name, dns.question.type, url.domain, http.method, user_agent, bytes_out]

required_concepts.description: Detects bursts of TXT queries to rare domains.
Requires DNS and proxy logs correlated by source IP/domain and time.
Proxy logic uses POST, user agent, byte threshold, and domain match.
SPF, verification, survey platforms, or scanners may match.
Tune rarity/count thresholds, provider allowlists, payload size, and domain reputation.

forbidden_concepts.description: Endpoint logs are enrichment, not required by this DNS/proxy rule.
Suspicious correlation does not prove C2 or exfiltration.
Known benign suffix filters should be honored.
